p1_issues.title: Retailer & Customer apps blocked by HTTP 500
p1_issues.description: Both apps return HTTP 500 on all requests due to module resolution errors in Turbopack middleware
p1_issues.evidence: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error - Cannot resolve @paon/domain
p1_issues.impact: Cannot test auth on 2 out of 3 apps

p2_issues.title: Missing brute force / rate limiting on login
p2_issues.description: No rate limiting on failed login attempts. An attacker can make unlimited rapid login attempts without throttling.
p2_issues.evidence: 5 rapid failed logins completed instantly with no delay or account lockout
p2_issues.test_command: for i in {1..5}; do curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/login -d 'email=contact@nebelspiegel.com&password=wrong_$i'; done
p2_issues.impact: Enables account enumeration and password guessing attacks (but not auth bypass)
p2_issues.risk: Medium - no bypass, but reduces account security
p2_issues.recommendation: Implement rate limiting: 5 attempts per email per 15 minutes using Vercel Rate Limiting or similar
